Singapore vs Brazil LIVE streaming info: When, where to watch SGP v BRA international friendly match?
 Find out all you need to know about the livestream and telecast info for the Singapore vs Brazil international friendly match to be played in Singapore.

 This is the last match of the 2026 calendar for Brazil, and it comes with an interesting matchup against the World No. 149 Singapore at the National Stadium in Singapore on Tuesday.
 Selecao will be looking to bounce back after the tough loss against Japan, 2-3; the match resulted in the suspension of Raphinha and Carlo Ancelloti, who received late red cards after arguing with the referee.
 This will be the first-ever football match between the two teams. This is a tough prospect for Singapore, which lost its last match 1-4 to Paraguay.
 When will the Singapore vs Brazil international friendly match kick off? 
 The Singapore vs Brazil international friendly match will kick off at 3:30 p.m. IST on Tuesday, November 17.
 Where will the Singapore vs Brazil international friendly match be played? 
 The Singapore vs Brazil international friendly match will be played at the National Stadium in Singapore.
 Where to watch the Singapore vs Brazil international friendly match? 
 The Singapore vs Brazil international friendly match will not be telecast anywhere in India. The match will be livestreamed on mWatch in Singapore and SporTV in Brazil .
